task.description:
Write test spec for DSL-08 (Function Purity).

BACKEND-DEV has already implemented 24 determinism tests + 1 now() type/range test directly in src/expr/mod.zig. Your job is to produce a formal test specification document at tests/specs/DSL-08.md that describes these tests.

The test spec should document:
1. Test strategy: determinism verification by calling each pure built-in twice with identical inputs and comparing outputs
2. Test environment: pure Zig unit tests, no DB required, no I/O
3. Test matrix (25 entries from the design artefact):
   - 24 determinism tests for: length, lower, upper, trim, contains, startsWith, endsWith, coalesce, date_add, date_diff
   - 1 type/range test for now() (the single exempted impure function)
4. Expected pass criteria for each test
5. Coverage requirements: every pure built-in must have at least 1 determinism test
acceptance_criteria: Test spec file created at tests/specs/DSL-08.md
All 25 tests documented with expression, expected behaviour, and purity classification
Coverage matrix shows every pure built-in has at least 1 determinism test

result.summary: Test specification for DSL-08 (Function Purity) completed. Created tests/specs/DSL-08.md documenting all 25 test cases: 24 determinism tests (covering length, lower, upper, trim, contains, startsWith, endsWith, coalesce, date_add, date_diff) and 1 now() type/range exemption test. Coverage matrix confirms every pure built-in has >=1 determinism test. Tests already implemented by BACKEND-DEV in src/expr/mod.zig via testDeterminism helper.
